title: handshake_timeout checked the connection before the refused attempt ended, racing two 5 s timeouts
description:
handshake_timeout arms a silent MODNAME reply and asserts !context.connected right after connect_focuser() returns false. connect_focuser() gives up after 5 s, the same time the unanswered read takes, so the CONNECTION property can still be BUSY with CONNECTED on. On Linux it failed in all 5 runs (before and after the library extraction, with and without FND-000049 fixed); the macOS records pass.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000051.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
